summary: Interpreted the repeat of the interface probe, which reproduced every count exactly: the dual-interface FSM again recorded 0 StoreConfiguration calls and 6 ApplyBatch configuration entries while the ConfigurationStore-only control recorded 6 and 0, and all four comparisons resolved as before. The account now cites both receipts, its single-execution limitation is replaced by the two-execution agreement — which is what makes the zero credible rather than an artifact of one run's timing — and the Fact was extended under its own id with the second receipt and the same conditions, keeping the premise unchanged. No earlier receipt was withdrawn and no execution requested. With roughly twenty-five minutes left, the run stands at six questions: four defects asserted (VerifyLeader counting a non-voter's acknowledgement toward a voter-sized quorum, with a stale read demonstrated end to end; LeadershipTransferToServer reporting success for a non-voter target while the cluster loses its leader for about 1.4 election timeouts; VerifyLeader futures stranded after Shutdown, pinned by a BatchApplyCh configuration flip; and StoreConfiguration never firing for an FSM that also batches, reproduced twice), plus two leads refuted — the stall-queued verify model and the uncommitted-configuration-history suspicion — each with its counterevidence recorded rather than left implicit.
